title: NAOS Evidence Envelope
description: DSSE-style signable envelope report over the evidence manifest root. NAOS emits the signable envelope but does not require signing, validate signatures, authenticate identities, hold keys, issue certificates, or provide non-repudiation.

identity_binding.description: Compatibility-named best-effort Git HEAD metadata. Git may report signature status and signer text; NAOS applies no independent signature trust or acceptance policy and does not authenticate an identity.

signed.description: Compatibility field indicating only whether signature entries are present; it is not a signature-validation result.

signature_validation_performed.description: NAOS performs no envelope or third-party signature validation.

adopter_signing_required.description: Compatibility field. Current NAOS emits false because signing is optional; legacy v1 true values remain schema-valid but do not establish a current kit requirement.
